name: ChroMeow
description: Two (or up to six) lifelike cats that live, climb, nap and play on the pages you browse. 100% local. Zero network. Zero telemetry.

toggle-click-through.description: Toggle Click-Through Lock (cats become fully non-interactive)

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
